title: Silas and the Silence
author: Ivo Eriksen
blurb: August Oyelaran, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
